name: track_then_log
title: First day · "track what I eat" gets a table at once, and "log two eggs" a row

steps.reply:
I've set up a **Food log** in a new Food module. It also has a **Calories per day** chart.

To add something, just tell me what you ate, like "two eggs and toast for breakfast" or "had a latte at 4". I'll note the time and the meal. If you don't give the calories, protein, carbs and fat, I'll estimate them and mark them as estimates. You can always correct a number.

Are you working toward anything, such as a calorie or protein target, losing weight, or spotting foods that don't agree with you? If you tell me, I'll show how each day compares.

What have you eaten so far today?

I logged two eggs as lunch today at 12:43: about **144 kcal**, with 12.6 g protein, 0.8 g carbs and 9.5 g fat.

I filled in some details myself. I assumed large eggs (about 50 g each) cooked without butter or oil, and took the numbers from standard nutrition figures (USDA). I also guessed the meal and time from when you told me. If you fried them in butter, ate them at breakfast, or they were a different size, tell me and I'll fix the entry.
